ingredients:
14 manicotti shells
15 oz ricotta
2 cups shredded mozzarella
1/2 cup grated Parmesan
1 egg
3 cups marinara sauce
Salt & pepper
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375°F. Boil shells to very al dente; drain.
2. Mix ricotta, mozzarella, Parmesan, egg, salt & pepper. Pipe/fill shells.
3. Spread sauce in 9x13; arrange stuffed shells; top with more sauce & cheese.
4. Bake 30–35 minutes.

ingredients:
1 large baguette
1/2 cup softened butter
3 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp chopped parsley
Pinch of salt
steps:
1. Mix butter, garlic, parsley, and salt.
2. Slice baguette, spread butter, bake at 375°F for 8–10 minutes.

ingredients:
3 romaine hearts, chopped
3/4 cup Caesar dressing (store-bought)
1 1/2 cups croutons
1/2 cup grated Parmesan
steps:
1. Toss romaine with dressing.
2. Top with croutons and Parmesan.

ingredients:
1 lb spaghetti
8 oz pancetta or bacon, diced
4 large eggs
1 cup grated Parmesan
1 tsp black pepper
Salt for pasta water
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti in salted water. In a bowl, whisk eggs, Parmesan, and black pepper.
2. Crisp pancetta/bacon. Off heat, toss hot drained pasta with pancetta and egg mixture, adding a splash of pasta water to get a silky sauce.
3. Serve immediately with extra cheese.

ingredients:
2 lb asparagus, trimmed
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp kosher salt
1/2 tsp black pepper
1 lemon (wedges)
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425°F. Toss asparagus with oil, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan.
2. Roast 10–12 minutes until tender-crisp. Serve with lemon.

ingredients:
1 can refrigerated pizza dough
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp kosher salt
Grated Parmesan (optional)
steps:
1. Cut dough into strips, twist, brush with oil and seasonings.
2. Bake 10–12 minutes at 400°F; sprinkle Parmesan.

ingredients:
9 lasagna noodles (no-boil or regular)
1 lb ground beef (or Italian sausage)
3 cups marinara sauce
15 oz ricotta
2 cups shredded mozzarella
1/2 cup grated Parmesan
Salt & pepper, to taste
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375°F. Brown beef; combine with marinara.
2. Layer noodles, ricotta, meat sauce, mozzarella in 9x13 pan; repeat; top with Parmesan.
3. Bake 35–45 minutes until bubbly; rest 10–15 minutes before slicing.

ingredients:
1 large loaf (24 oz)
Butter (optional)
steps:
1. Warm in a 350°F oven until crusty and heated through.
2. Serve with butter.

ingredients:
2 romaine hearts, chopped
2 cups mixed greens or spinach
1/2 cup vinaigrette (store-bought)
1/2 cup croutons
1/3 cup grated Parmesan (optional)
steps:
1. Toss greens with dressing just before serving.
2. Top with croutons and Parmesan.

ingredients:
1 lb spaghetti
1 (24-oz) jar marinara sauce
2 tbsp olive oil
Salt for pasta water
Parmesan, to serve
steps:
1. Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
2. Warm marinara with olive oil; toss pasta with sauce. Serve with Parmesan.

ingredients:
5 thin chicken cutlets (~1.75 lb)
1 cup breadcrumbs
1/2 cup grated Parmesan
2 eggs, beaten
2 cups marinara sauce
2 cups shredded mozzarella
1 tsp kosher salt
1/2 tsp pepper
steps:
1. Bread cutlets: egg then breadcrumbs mixed with Parmesan and seasoning.
2. Bake at 425°F for 12 minutes; top with sauce and mozzarella; bake 8–10 minutes more.

ingredients:
1 whole chicken (4.5–5 lb)
2 tbsp olive oil
2 tsp kosher salt
1 tsp black pepper
1 lemon, halved (optional)
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425°F. Pat chicken dry; rub with oil, salt, pepper.
2. Roast breast‑side up on a rack or vegetables until thickest breast hits 160–165°F (about 60–80 minutes for 4.5–5 lb).
3. Rest 10–15 minutes; carve.

ingredients:
2.5 lb Yukon gold potatoes, peeled & cubed
6 tbsp butter
3/4 cup warm milk or half-and-half
1 1/4 tsp kosher salt
1/2 tsp black pepper
steps:
1. Boil potatoes in salted water until tender (15–20 min). Drain.
2. Mash with butter and milk. Season to taste.

ingredients:
1 large loaf (24 oz)
Butter (optional)
steps:
1. Warm in a 350°F oven until crusty and heated through.
2. Serve with butter.

ingredients:
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
3 carrots, sliced
3 celery stalks, sliced
10 cups chicken broth
2 cups cooked chicken (rotisserie), shredded
8 oz egg noodles
Salt & pepper
steps:
1. Sauté onion, carrots, celery in oil 5 minutes. Add broth; bring to a simmer.
2. Add noodles; cook until just tender (per package, ~7–8m). Stir in cooked chicken; heat through. Salt & pepper to taste.

ingredients:
2 romaine hearts, chopped
2 cups mixed greens or spinach
1/2 cup vinaigrette (store-bought)
1/2 cup croutons
1/3 cup grated Parmesan (optional)
steps:
1. Toss greens with dressing just before serving.
2. Top with croutons and Parmesan.

ingredients:
4 cups all‑purpose flour
2 tsp kosher salt
1/2 tsp instant yeast
1 1/2 cups warm water (≈105–110°F)
Flour for dusting
steps:
1. In a bowl, whisk flour, salt, yeast. Stir in warm water until a shaggy dough forms.
2. Cover and let rise at room temp until doubled, 1 1/2–2 1/2 hours (depends on kitchen temp).
3. Dust hands and shape into a round; set in a floured pan or parchment.
4. Heat oven to 450°F. If using a Dutch oven, preheat it as well.
5. Bake: 30 minutes covered (or in the pan), then uncover and bake 12–18 minutes more to deep golden.
6. Cool 20–30 minutes before slicing.

ingredients:
3 cups shredded cooked chicken
10 corn or flour tortillas
3 cups red enchilada sauce (canned)
2 cups shredded cheese
1/2 cup chopped onion (optional)
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375°F. Warm tortillas.
2. Fill with chicken and some cheese; roll and place seam‑side down in sauced pan.
3. Top with sauce & cheese; cover for first 15 minutes, then uncover 8–10 minutes until bubbly.

ingredients: 1 large bag tortilla chips
steps: 1. Open bag and serve with salsa or guacamole.

ingredients:
2.5 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs
1 cup teriyaki sauce (bottle)
1 tbsp oil
steps:
1. Sear chicken 3–4 minutes per side; pour in teriyaki sauce.
2. Simmer 5–8 minutes until glazed and cooked through (165°F).

ingredients:
2 1/2 cups jasmine rice, rinsed
3 cups water
1/2 tsp kosher salt
steps:
1. Rinse rice until water runs mostly clear. Combine rice, water, salt; bring to a boil.
2. Cover; reduce heat to low; cook 15 minutes. Off heat, rest 5 minutes; fluff.

ingredients:
2 lb broccoli florets
3 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp kosher salt
1/2 tsp black pepper
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425°F. Toss broccoli with oil, salt, pepper.
2. Roast 16–18 minutes, tossing once, until edges are browned.

ingredients:
2 lb ground beef
1 cup breadcrumbs
2 eggs
1/2 cup milk
1 small onion, minced
1 1/2 tsp kosher salt
1/2 tsp pepper
1/2 cup ketchup (plus more for glaze)
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350°F. Mix beef, breadcrumbs, eggs, milk, onion, salt, pepper.
2. Form a loaf in a 9x5 pan or on a lined sheet. Top with ketchup.
3. Bake 50–60 minutes to 160°F internal. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

ingredients:
2 lb carrots, peeled & sliced on bias
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp kosher salt
1/2 tsp black pepper
1 tbsp honey (optional)
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425°F. Toss carrots with oil, salt, pepper.
2. Roast 22–25 minutes until tender. Drizzle with honey if using.

ingredients:
3.5 lb chuck roast
2 tsp kosher salt
1 tsp pepper
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, quartered
4 carrots, chunks
2 cups beef broth
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325°F. Salt/pepper roast; sear in Dutch oven.
2. Add onion, carrots, and beef broth to come 1/3 up the meat. Cover.
3. Braise 2.5–3.5 hours until fork‑tender; rest 10 minutes; slice/chunk and serve.

ingredients:
2.5 lb baby potatoes, halved
3 tbsp olive oil
1 1/4 tsp kosher salt
1/2 tsp black pepper
1 tsp garlic powder
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425°F. Toss potatoes with oil and seasonings.
2. Roast cut-side down 30–35 minutes until golden.

ingredients:
2 lb baby carrots
3 tbsp butter
2 tbsp honey
1/2 tsp kosher salt
steps:
1. Simmer carrots in salted water until just tender; drain.
2. Add butter and honey; cook 2–3 minutes to glaze.

ingredients:
2.5–3 lb tri-tip roast
2 tsp kosher salt
2 tsp coarse black pepper
1 tsp garlic powder
steps:
1. Season tri-tip all over. Heat smoker to 225°F.
2. Smoke until internal temp 128–130°F (about 1.5–2 hrs).
3. Rest 10 minutes; slice against the grain.

ingredients:
10 small rolls
Butter (optional)
steps:
1. Arrange frozen Rhodes rolls on a greased sheet; cover.
2. Let rise until puffy, ~3 hours at room temp.
3. Bake 10–12 minutes per package directions until golden.

ingredients:
10 slices rye bread
1.5 lb sliced corned beef
10 slices Swiss cheese
1 1/2 cups sauerkraut, drained
1/2 cup Thousand Island or Russian dressing
Butter for griddle
steps:
1. Butter bread; layer corned beef, sauerkraut (squeezed dry), cheese, and dressing.
2. Griddle sandwiches until golden and cheese melts.

ingredients: 1 family-size bag potato chips
steps: 1. Open bag and serve in a bowl.

ingredients:
1.5 lb coleslaw mix
3/4 cup coleslaw dressing (store-bought)
steps: 1. Toss mix with dressing; chill 10 minutes.

ingredients:
3.5 lb pork shoulder
1 tbsp kosher salt
2 tsp garlic powder
2 tsp paprika
1 cup barbecue sauce
5 buns
steps:
1. Season pork and cook in slow cooker on LOW 8 hours.
2. Shred and toss with barbecue sauce; serve on buns.

ingredients: 10 dill pickle spears
steps: 1. Chill and serve pickle spears alongside the main.

ingredients:
15 slices bacon
10 slices sandwich bread, toasted
2 large tomatoes, sliced
5 leaves romaine or butter lettuce
1/2 cup mayonnaise
Salt & pepper
steps:
1. Cook bacon until crisp; drain.
2. Toast bread; spread with mayonnaise.
3. Layer bacon, tomato, lettuce; season with salt & pepper.

ingredients: 1 family-size bag potato chips
steps: 1. Open bag and serve in a bowl.

ingredients:
2.5 lb mixed fruit (berries, melon, grapes)
Juice of 1/2 lemon (optional)
steps: 1. Cube/slice fruit and toss gently with lemon juice.

ingredients:
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
2 (4-oz) cans diced green chiles
2 tsp cumin
1 tsp oregano
6 cups chicken broth
3 cups shredded cooked chicken
3 (15-oz) cans white beans, rinsed
1/2 cup sour cream
1/2 cup half-and-half (or milk)
Salt & pepper
steps:
1. Sauté onion in oil; brown beef with chili powder, cumin, salt.
2. Stir in crushed tomatoes and beans; simmer gently 30–45 minutes; adjust seasoning.

ingredients:
2 boxes cornbread mix (8.5 oz each)
Ingredients per package (usually eggs & milk)
steps: 1. Prepare batter per package. Bake in 9x13 pan 18–22 minutes.

ingredients:
2 lb 80/20 ground beef
5 hamburger buns
5 slices cheddar or American cheese
1 tsp kosher salt
1/2 tsp black pepper
Oil for grill or skillet
steps:
1. Form 5 patties; season with salt & pepper.
2. Cook on hot grill/skillet 3–4 min/side to desired doneness (160°F for well‑done).
3. Add cheese to melt; serve on buns.

ingredients:
10 hot dogs
10 hot dog buns
Condiments (ketchup, mustard, relish)
steps:
1. Grill or boil hot dogs 5–8 minutes.
2. Serve in buns with condiments.

ingredients:
2 (28-oz) cans baked beans
2 tbsp brown sugar (optional)
1 tbsp mustard (optional)
steps: 1. Bake beans at 350°F until bubbly, 20–25 minutes; stir in sugar/mustard if desired.

ingredients:
2.5 lb Yukon gold potatoes, 1-inch cubes
3/4 cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp mustard
1/2 cup chopped celery
1/4 cup chopped red onion
1 tsp kosher salt
1/2 tsp pepper
steps:
1. Boil potatoes until tender; drain and cool.
2. Toss with remaining ingredients; chill.

ingredients:
3.5 lb pork shoulder
1 tbsp kosher salt
1 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp cumin
1 tsp oregano
1 cup orange juice
15 small corn tortillas
steps:
1. Season pork and slow cook on LOW ~8 hours with orange juice.
2. Shred; crisp edges in a hot skillet if desired. Serve on warmed tortillas.

ingredients:
4 cups frozen corn
1 tbsp butter
2 tbsp mayonnaise
2 tbsp sour cream
1/2 tsp chili powder
1/2 tsp kosher salt
2 tbsp chopped cilantro
1 tbsp lime juice
1/4 cup crumbled cotija (optional)
steps:
1. Sauté corn in butter until lightly charred.
2. Off heat, stir in mayo, sour cream, chili powder, salt, cilantro, and lime. Top with cotija.

ingredients:
3 (15-oz) cans black beans, drained & rinsed
1/2 cup salsa
1 tsp cumin
1/2 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp kosher salt
steps:
1. Rinse beans. Combine with salsa, cumin, garlic powder, and salt; simmer 8–10 minutes.
2. Mash a few beans to thicken if desired.

ingredients:
10 eggs
2 tbsp butter
1/2 tsp kosher salt
Black pepper, to taste
steps: 1. Cook eggs in butter over medium-low heat to desired doneness; season with salt and pepper.

ingredients:
3 cups pancake mix (complete)
2 1/4 cups water
Butter or oil for griddle
Maple syrup, to serve
steps:
1. Mix batter per package; rest 2 minutes.
2. Cook pancakes on greased griddle 2–3 minutes per side.

ingredients: 1 lb thick-cut bacon
steps: 1. Bake on a rack over a sheet pan at 400°F for 16–20 minutes.

ingredients:
10 flour tortillas (8-inch)
3 cups shredded cheese (Monterey Jack/cheddar)
Oil or butter for skillet
steps:
1. Heat tortilla in lightly oiled skillet; sprinkle cheese; top with another tortilla.
2. Cook 2–3 minutes per side until golden and melted; cut into wedges.

ingredients: 2 cups salsa (jarred)
steps: 1. Serve salsa in bowls with chips; optionally stir in lime juice and cilantro.

ingredients: 5 ripe avocados, mashed with lime & salt
steps:
1. Mash avocados with 2 tbsp lime juice and 1 tsp salt.
2. Optional: add 1/4 cup diced onion and cilantro.

ingredients:
10 eggs
1 cup prepared chile verde (jarred)
1 cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese
2 tbsp butter
Salt & pepper
steps:
1. Whisk eggs with salt and pepper. Melt butter in nonstick skillet.
2. Cook omelets in batches: add eggs, sprinkle cheese, fold, and top with warm chile verde.

ingredients:
10 slices sandwich bread
10 slices cheddar or American cheese
4 tbsp softened butter
steps:
1. Butter bread; sandwich cheese between slices.
2. Cook in skillet over medium heat until golden and melty, 2–3 minutes per side.

ingredients:
2 (32-oz) cartons tomato soup (or 4 cans condensed + milk)
1/2 cup cream or milk (optional)
steps: 1. Heat soup in saucepan; stir in cream to taste.

ingredients:
2 lb large shrimp, peeled & deveined
1 lb mixed stir-fry vegetables
3 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp oyster sauce (or teriyaki)
2 tbsp oil
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp grated ginger (optional)
steps:
1. Stir-fry shrimp in hot oil 2–3 minutes; remove.
2. Sauté vegetables 3–4 minutes; add sauces and shrimp; toss until hot.

ingredients:
2 lb frozen edamame in pods
1 tbsp kosher salt (for water)
Flaky salt to finish
steps: 1. Boil edamame 4–5 minutes. Drain and sprinkle with flaky salt.

ingredients:
5 cups cooked, chilled rice
1 lb mixed frozen vegetables
4 eggs, beaten
3 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp oil
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp sesame oil (optional)
steps:
1. Heat oil; scramble eggs softly and set aside.
2. Sauté garlic and vegetables 3–4 minutes; add rice and soy sauce; stir-fry until hot.
3. Stir in eggs; finish with sesame oil.

ingredients:
1.5 lb mixed vegetables (frozen blend)
1/2 tsp kosher salt
1 tbsp butter (optional)
steps: 1. Steam or microwave veggies until tender; season with salt and butter.

ingredients:
5 eggs
2 tbsp butter
1/2 tsp kosher salt
Black pepper, to taste
steps: 1. Cook eggs in butter over medium-low heat to desired doneness; season with salt and pepper.

ingredients:
10 thick slices bread (brioche/texas toast)
6 eggs
1 1/4 cups milk
2 tbsp sugar
1 tsp vanilla
1/2 tsp cinnamon
Butter for griddle
steps:
1. Whisk eggs, milk, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon.
2. Dip bread and cook on buttered griddle 2–3 minutes per side.

ingredients:
2.5 lb mahi-mahi fillets
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp kosher salt
1/2 tsp pepper
Lemon wedges
steps:
1. Heat and oil grill. Pat fillets dry; oil and season.
2. Grill 3–4 minutes/side until opaque and flakes easily (130–135°F).

ingredients:
5 ears corn, husked
Butter, salt (to serve)
steps: 1. Boil corn 6–8 minutes until tender. Serve with butter and salt.

ingredients:
2.5 lb cod fillets
1 cup panko breadcrumbs
2 tbsp olive oil
1/2 cup flour
2 eggs, beaten
1 tsp kosher salt
1/2 tsp pepper
Lemon wedges, to serve
steps:
1. Bread fish by dredging in flour, egg, then panko mixed with oil and seasonings.
2. Bake at 425°F for 12–15 minutes until flaky.

ingredients:
16 oz smoked salmon
Lemon wedges
Capers (optional)
steps: 1. Arrange smoked salmon on plates with lemon and capers. Serve chilled or at room temp.

ingredients:
2 lb asparagus, trimmed
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp kosher salt
1/2 tsp black pepper
1 lemon (wedges)
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425°F. Toss asparagus with oil, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan.
2. Roast 10–12 minutes until tender-crisp. Serve with lemon.

ingredients:
2 tbsp butter
1/2 cup orzo (optional)
2 cups long-grain rice
3 1/4 cups chicken broth
1/2 tsp kosher salt
steps:
1. Rinse rice until water runs mostly clear. Combine rice, water, salt; bring to a boil.
2. Cover; reduce heat to low; cook 15 minutes. Off heat, rest 5 minutes; fluff.

ingredients:
2.5 lb salmon fillet
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp kosher salt
1/2 tsp pepper
Lemon slices
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400°F. Place salmon on lined sheet; brush with oil; salt & pepper.
2. Bake 12–14 minutes until center is just opaque (125–130°F). Rest 3 minutes; serve with lemon.

ingredients:
2.5 lb sweet potatoes, 1-inch cubes
3 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp kosher salt
1/2 tsp black pepper
1 tsp smoked paprika (optional)
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425°F. Toss cubes with oil and seasonings.
2. Roast 28–32 minutes until tender, stirring once.

ingredients:
2 romaine hearts, chopped
2 cups mixed greens or spinach
1/2 cup vinaigrette (store-bought)
1/2 cup croutons
1/3 cup grated Parmesan (optional)
steps:
1. Toss greens with dressing just before serving.
2. Top with croutons and Parmesan.

ingredients:
2 lb shrimp, peeled & deveined
2 tsp chili powder
1 tsp cumin
1 tsp kosher salt
2 tbsp oil
15 small corn tortillas
steps:
1. Season shrimp; sauté in oil 2–3 minutes until pink.
2. Warm tortillas and assemble with slaw and lime crema.

ingredients:
1.5 lb coleslaw mix
3/4 cup coleslaw dressing (store-bought)
steps: 1. Toss mix with dressing; chill 10 minutes.

ingredients:
1 cup sour cream
1 tbsp lime juice
1/2 tsp lime zest
1/4 tsp salt
steps: 1. Stir together all ingredients; chill until serving.
